item.name: Drugstore
item.description: Drugstore consumer, doctor, and internal integration flows. Run address and pharmacy discovery first, then move into cart, prescription, and order flows.

request.description:
Discover delivery-capable pharmacies for the selected location.

Query params:
- addressId: Saved delivery address to use as the discovery anchor.
- latitude / longitude: Optional raw coordinates if you are not using a saved address.
- search: Optional free-text filter for pharmacy name.
- page / limit: Pagination controls.

Consumption notes:
- Use this before catalog browsing when your UI starts from pharmacy selection.
- If the user already has an active cart, the response can include compatibility hints for that cart.

Fetch the pharmacy profile used by the consumer-facing about screen.

Path params:
- merchantId: Merchant / pharmacy identifier returned from nearby pharmacy discovery.

Consumption notes:
- Use this for profile/about sections, operating hours, delivery capability, and top-level pharmacy metadata.

Fetch paginated pharmacy reviews.

Query params:
- page: Review page number.
- limit: Page size.

Consumption notes:
- Current implementation may return placeholder review data until review persistence is expanded.

List pharmacy catalog products.

Query params:
- merchantId: Pharmacy whose catalog should be loaded.
- page / limit: Pagination.
- search: Optional keyword search.
- category: Optional category filter.
- sortBy: createdAt | price | name.
- sortDirection: asc | desc.

Consumption notes:
- Use this for the product grid/list after a pharmacy has been selected.

Fetch one product's detailed information.

Path params:
- productId: Product identifier from the catalog list.

Query params:
- merchantId: Required because the drugstore catalog is pharmacy-scoped.

List available catalog categories for a pharmacy.

Query params:
- merchantId: Pharmacy identifier whose categories should be loaded.

Check whether a discount code applies to the current cart composition.

Body fields:
- merchantId: Pharmacy / merchant identifier.
- code: Coupon code in uppercase.
- orderAmount: Current item subtotal before delivery.
- productIds: Products currently in cart.

Consumption notes:
- Use this before order creation if your UI lets the user test a coupon code independently.

Return the signed-in user's saved delivery addresses.

Consumption notes:
- Use this to populate the address selection bottom sheet during checkout.

Create a delivery address.

Body fields:
- label: Friendly name shown to the user.
- addressLine1 / addressLine2: Street address lines.
- city / state: Delivery location fields.
- recipientName / recipientPhone: Who receives the order.
- isDefault: Whether this becomes the default address.
- latitude / longitude: Optional coordinates for location-aware discovery.

Update an existing saved address.

Path params:
- addressId: Address identifier from List/Create Address.

Body fields:
- Send only the fields you want to change; the schema accepts the same fields as address creation.

body.raw:
{
  "label": "My Main Address",
  "addressLine1": "6, Solaru Street",
  "addressLine2": "Soluyi, Gbagada",
  "city": "Lagos",
  "state": "Lagos",
  "recipientName": "Tamara Ike",
  "recipientPhone": "08055713517",
  "isDefault": true
}

request.description:
Delete a saved delivery address.

Path params:
- addressId: Address to remove from the user's address book.

Upload a prescription file before formal submission.

Form-data fields:
- file: The prescription image or PDF from the tester's local machine.

Consumption notes:
- This only uploads the file and creates a draft prescription record. Submit it in the next request to attach patient and pharmacy context.

Submit an uploaded prescription for merchant review.

Path params:
- prescriptionId: Draft prescription identifier from the upload step.

Body fields:
- merchantId: Pharmacy that should review the prescription.
- cartId: Optional current cart identifier if the prescription is tied to a live cart.
- patientName: Name on the prescription.
- prescriptionDate: ISO date string.
- isForSelf: Whether the order is for the signed-in user.

List the signed-in user's prescriptions and review states.

Consumption notes:
- Use this to poll for merchant approval, rejection, or clarification after submission.

Fetch a single prescription record with its current workflow state.

Path params:
- prescriptionId: Identifier captured from upload or list responses.

Return the active single-pharmacy cart for the current user.

Consumption notes:
- The backend enforces one active pharmacy cart at a time. Use this to restore in-progress cart state on app launch.

Add one product to the active cart.

Body fields:
- merchantId: Pharmacy identifier.
- merchantProductId: Product identifier from the catalog.
- quantity: Desired quantity.

Consumption notes:
- The backend rejects mixing products from multiple pharmacies in one active cart.

Change the quantity of a cart line item.

Path params:
- itemId: Cart item identifier from the active cart response.

Body fields:
- quantity: New integer quantity (minimum 1).

Remove a line item from the active cart.

Path params:
- itemId: Cart item identifier from Add/Get Cart.

Create a pending drugstore order and initialize Paystack payment.

Body fields:
- paymentMethod: card or bank_transfer for the first-pass flow.
- couponCode: Optional uppercase coupon code.
- addressId: Saved delivery address id. Falls back to the default address if omitted and one exists.
- deliveryNote: Optional note for dispatch.
- deliveryDate: Optional ISO date string.
- deliveryTimeSlot: Optional display slot selected by the user.
- returnUrl: Optional frontend callback URL for the payment redirect flow.

Consumption notes:
- Delivery totals are computed on the backend.
- If the cart contains prescription-only items, an approved prescription must already exist.

Verify the payment reference for a pending order.

Path params:
- orderId: Pending order id from Create Order.

Body fields:
- paymentReference: Paystack reference returned from the payment initialization response or callback.
- providerStatus: Optional UI hint; backend verification is authoritative.

List the signed-in user's drugstore orders.

Query params:
- page / limit: Pagination.
- paymentStatus: pending | paid | failed.
- deliveryStatus: pending | picked_up | in_transit | delivered | cancelled.
- dateRange: today | yesterday | last_7_days | last_30_days.
- ageBucket: lt_24h | between_24h_48h | gt_48h.

Fetch a single drugstore order, including computed totals and delivery/prescription linkage.

Path params:
- orderId: Identifier from Create/List Orders.

Cancel an order when the current workflow state allows it.

Body fields:
- reason: Optional human-readable reason for the cancellation request.

item.name: Internal (service-to-service)
item.description: Internal endpoints used by the merchant app for prescription review and fulfillment sync. These routes require HMAC-signed headers. The folder pre-request script calculates the required headers from environment variables.

request.description:
Return prescriptions awaiting action for a specific pharmacy.

Query params:
- merchantId: Pharmacy / merchant identifier.
- status: Optional workflow status filter.

Approve, reject, or request clarification for a submitted prescription.

Path params:
- prescriptionId: Prescription under review.

Body fields:
- action: approved | rejected | needs_clarification.
- note: Optional message shown to the consumer.
- reviewerName / reviewerId: Optional override fields for audit context.

Push a merchant-side fulfillment update back into experience_1.

Body fields:
- merchantOrderId: Merchant app order identifier.
- sourceOrderId: Original experience_1 order identifier.
- merchantId: Merchant performing the update.
- deliveryStatus: pending | picked_up | in_transit | delivered | cancelled.
- note: Optional status note for timeline/history.

exec: try { bodyForHash = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(raw)); } catch (_e) { bodyForHash = raw; }
